fallopian_tube.name: Fallopian Tube (Oviduct)
fallopian_tube.description: Ciliated muscular duct connecting ovary to uterus; normal anatomical site of fertilization and early cleavage of the zygote.

fimbriae.name: Fimbriae (Infundibulum Fringes)
fimbriae.description: Finger-like ciliated projections draping over the ovary that actively sweep the released secondary oocyte into the fallopian tube.

ovary.name: Ovary (Female Gonad)
ovary.description: Female primary reproductive organ producing ova (eggs) via oogenesis and secreting hormones estrogen and progesterone.

uterus_myometrium.name: Uterus (Muscular Myometrium)
uterus_myometrium.description: Thick smooth-muscle wall of the womb that stretches during gestation and contracts rhythmically under oxytocin stimulation during labor.

cervix.name: Cervix
cervix.description: Narrow muscular neck at the base of the uterus protruding into the vagina; dilates to 10 cm during parturition (childbirth).

endometrium.name: Endometrium (Uterine Lining)
endometrium.description: Highly vascular glandular inner lining that thickens under estrogen and progesterone for blastocyst implantation, shedding during menstruation.

vagina.name: Vagina (Birth Canal)
vagina.description: Elastic fibromuscular canal extending from cervix to outside; serves as female copulatory organ and passage for menstrual flow and childbirth.
